HOW-TOHow to replace lower control arms

May 10, 2014
Here is how I swapped both front lower control arms on my 2008 Xterra Off-Road.
Tools: 21mm and 19mm sockets, a breaker bar, a jack stand pair and a pickle fork.
  • Loosen the lug nuts, raise the front, and support it on stands.
  • Remove the lower ball joint nut and separate the knuckle with the pickle fork.
  • Pull the inner pivot bolts and drop the arm. The pivot bolts are tight, so use the breaker bar.
Torque the inner pivot bolts to 83 ft-lb with the suspension loaded. New arm part number 54500-EA000.
May 10, 2014
Torque the inner pivot bolts to 83 ft-lb
Confirming 83 ft-lb on my 2010. Do the final torque with the weight of the truck on the suspension, not on stands, or the bushings bind.
